title: Readable retained HTML and honest execution closeout
description: Use an isolated gateway/store with orchestration disabled. Seed a retained report containing readable sources, full criteria, PASS and unproved cases, embedded screenshots, sticky navigation and native details/filters. Open its run on the validation UI. Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY, FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT, FARMSLOT_UI_URL and FARMSLOT_HTML_REPORT_ROUTE. For the hostile node select a separate retained hostile-report.html containing script, event-handler, remote image/CSS, iframe, form and javascript-link probes; set FARMSLOT_HTML_HOSTILE_ROUTE. For closeout seed a separate blocked artifact-only run titled disposable-partial-output-close with finished worker output, partial metrics and original failed/skipped steps; set FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_CLOSE_RUN_ID/FARMSLOT_OUTPUT_CLOSE_ROUTE. Never target a real user run. Tests read the real gateway and send real CDP input; they do not inject UI state. For family outcomes set FARMSLOT_VALIDATION_ROOT to this isolated checkout, run node scripts/e2e-family-outcome.mjs --seed, then restart only its isolated gateway to load the disposable fixtures.

human-report.intent: The report viewer exposes complete coverage and linked evidence safely.

hostile-report.intent: Untrusted reports cannot execute code or escape their isolated viewer.

close-execution.intent: Closing execution preserves reviewed evidence and reports incomplete outcomes.

family-outcome.intent: Family success depends on successful terminal work and pending siblings.
